description.text: The promos of the Sun & Moon Series, numbered SM01 to SM248 and released from November 2016 to November 2021. The set began with the Alola Collection, out the same day as the Pokémon Sun and Moon games, and the prefix changed from XY to SM. Most came in collections, blisters, boxes, premium collections and tins, with prerelease promos and their staff copies alongside. Some went further afield: cards in General Mills cereal mini packs, Ash's Pikachu at screenings of I Choose You!, and a run of cards for the POKÉMON Detective Pikachu film, at its screenings, at in-store events and in its case files. The World Championships trophy card Champions Festival came out in 2017, 2018 and 2019.

description.text: Champions Festival was the promo card of the 2019 Pokémon World Championships, held from 16 to 18 August 2019 at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center in Washington, D.C. Competitors received the card in eight languages, staff got a Staff copy, and the top finishers in each division got copies stamped with their placement, from Top Thirty-Two up to Champion. How many trophy copies were handed out changed from year to year.
